definition: F-57. For each hit, place an "X" in the HIT column. For a miss, place an "O" in the MISS column. Allow 10 points for each target hit, whether the firer hits it with the first or second burst. The firer must score between 70 and 110 points to qualify.
F-58. For each hit, place an "X" in the HIT column; for each miss, place an "O" in the MISS column. The firer must score between 6 and 11 hits to qualify.

F-59.
